title: VB6 COM Object Dependency Analysis
problem_statement: VB6 application uses 12+ COM objects that need compatibility assessment for modernization
risk_if_unaddressed: Application will fail to run in modern environments without COM object registration
suggested_approach: Create inventory of all COM dependencies, identify modern equivalents, and create compatibility matrix
success_criteria: Complete COM object inventory with GUIDs
Migration path defined for each COM object

title: Access Database Migration Strategy
problem_statement: BANK1.mdb Access database needs migration to modern database system with schema preservation
risk_if_unaddressed: Data loss, performance issues, and scalability limitations in production
suggested_approach: Extract schema, create migration scripts, implement data validation, and establish rollback procedures

title: Banking Application Security Framework
problem_statement: VB6 banking app has basic login forms but lacks modern authentication, authorization, and audit trails
risk_if_unaddressed: Security vulnerabilities, compliance failures, and unauthorized access to financial data
suggested_approach: Implement OAuth2/OIDC, role-based access control, session management, and audit logging
success_criteria: Comprehensive audit trail for all transactions

provenance.evidence: Basic login form without modern security

title: Multi-Agent System Resilience
problem_statement: Agent system lacks proper error isolation, circuit breakers, and failure recovery mechanisms
risk_if_unaddressed: Cascading failures across agent network, difficult debugging, and system instability
suggested_approach: Implement circuit breaker pattern, structured logging, health checks, and graceful degradation
success_criteria: Circuit breakers implemented for agent communication
Health check endpoints for all agents

provenance.evidence: Base agent class without error handling patterns

title: Environment Configuration Management
problem_statement: Hardcoded paths and configuration values prevent deployment flexibility and environment promotion
risk_if_unaddressed: Deployment failures, configuration drift, and inability to support multiple environments
suggested_approach: Implement 12-factor app configuration with environment variables and configuration management
success_criteria: All hardcoded values externalized to configuration
